source.title: Rasuwa Flood Situation Report #01
source.author: Government of Nepal, National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA)
source.note: Every figure here is quoted from this one report at this one timestamp. Numbers circulating elsewhere for this event disagree with each other by an order of magnitude; this page quotes NDRRMA or nothing.

mechanism.detachment_setting: north-facing slope near the Lhende river, rock-glacier material
mechanism.process: the detached ice and rock entrained loose proglacial sediment and transformed into a highly mobile sediment- and water-laden debris flow, temporarily damming the river before releasing

timeline_local_npt.event: Ice-rock avalanche in the upper watershed near the Nepal-China border reaches Lhende Khola
Bhote Koshi-Syafrubesi hydrological station stops transmitting; last water level 1.62 m
DHM confirms a major flood wave and issues downstream warnings for the Trishuli corridor
Peak discharge at Devghat, approximately 5,850 m³/s

claim_boundary: This block is a quotation of an official report, not a product of this project's model. Nothing on this site measures casualties, damage or discharge.
